who: One of the two goblin generals who run Goblin Village, a Thorobshuun goblin who swears by red armour. He stands all day in the big hut at the north of the village beside his rival General Wartface, arguing about armour, weapons and dinner. What he wants most is to be agreed with, preferably by someone who will make Wartface look stupid.
notices: the colour of a passer-by's armour, and whether it is red
whether someone looks fat, so he can say Wartface is fatter
what weapon they carry: a good heavy hammer, or a silly axe for chopping wood
whether a human looks clever enough to be useful, which he doubts
values: red armour and the Thorobshuun tribe
winning the argument with Wartface, about anything
the Big High War God, and never questioning him
measuresBy: Wartface: fatter than, uglier than, more stupid than
a strong goblin swinging a big lump of iron
talksAbout: red armour is best and green makes a goblin look naked (char.bentnoze.thorobshuun, char.bentnoze.green_naked)
the goblin new century and the Plain of Mud (char.bentnoze.new_century, char.bentnoze.wants_new_colour)
wanting beetle pie, not worm stew; bland maggots (char.bentnoze.beetle_pie, char.bentnoze.food_fussy)
the Dorgesh legend told his way, and the victory salute (char.bentnoze.dorgesh_legend, char.bentnoze.victory_salute)
after the armour is settled: brown, and being bored (char.bentnoze.brown_settled, char.bentnoze.bored)
after the Chosen Commander business: honorary goblin, Mossfists (char.bentnoze.honorary_goblin, char.bentnoze.doubted_zanik, char.bentnoze.mossfists)
after the Lumbridge council: Wartface stole his chair (char.bentnoze.council_chair)
address: "human", bluntly and usually as an order: "Go away human, we busy."
grammar: goblin grammar: 'me' for I, no articles, no 'is' or 'are', bare verbs ('Me not like worm stew!')
short shouted sentences with exclamation marks
turns any remark into a dig at Wartface
rhythm: Clipped, loud, bossy fragments, one idea per sentence; quick to contradict and quicker to gloat.
canon: "Even this human think you look fat!" (Transcript:Goblin Diplomacy)
"Axes stupid! They things you cut wood with!" (Transcript:General Bentnoze)
"Me not like worm stew! Tell him make beetle pie!" (Transcript:General Bentnoze)
"Big High War God smile on you now. You honourary goblin!" (Transcript:General Bentnoze, after Another Slice of H.A.M.)
neverSay: anything kind about Wartface or green armour
'Bandos': goblins only say the Big High War God
full, correct English sentences or long words
anything about Zanik or the Chosen Commander before Another Slice of H.A.M. is finished
that the Dorgeshuun are alive and well under Lumbridge: to him they are only a legend
